mod.name: TB Car Dealer
mod.summary: A vehicle dealership. Players browse a showroom, buy vehicles, sell their own and can test drive models. Prices and variants come from car and price item files.

files.title: Category order
files.summary: Order of vehicle categories at each dealer.

version.label: Format version
version.help: Version number of this file format. The mod uses it to upgrade old files. Never change it.

categorieOrder.*.label: Category order of this dealer
categorieOrder.*.help: Order in which vehicle categories appear at the dealer. The key is the dealer name. New categories are added automatically at reload and restart.

categorieOrder.*[].label: Category name
categorieOrder.*[].help: One category name as used in car configs.

files.title: Car (one file per car)
files.summary: A car with its variants, category, test drive and reputation rules.

uniqueName.label: Car id
uniqueName.help: Name of this car entry. Must match the file name. Dealers refer to it by this name.

items.label: Items (internal)
items.help: Reserved by the mod. Do not change.

uniqueCarNames.label: Car variants
uniqueCarNames.help: Names of price item files (PriceItems folder) that make up this car and its colour or equipment variants.

uniqueCarNames[].label: Variant file name
uniqueCarNames[].help: Name of one price item file in PriceItems.

category.label: Category
category.help: Group this car is shown under at the dealer.

canUsedForTestDrive.label: Allow test drive
canUsedForTestDrive.help: Lets players test the car. Needs a test drive start position on the dealer point.

maxDistanceToTestDriveSpawnPosition.label: Test drive range
maxDistanceToTestDriveSpawnPosition.help: How far from the start spot the player may drive before the test ends.

maxTimeInSecondsForTestDrive.label: Test drive time
maxTimeInSecondsForTestDrive.help: How long a test drive lasts. It also ends when the player leaves the car or the range.

enablePoints.label: Use reputation
enablePoints.help: Switches reputation rules for this car on. When off, the limits below are ignored.

minPointsNeededForBuy.label: Minimum reputation to buy
minPointsNeededForBuy.help: Lowest reputation a player may have and still buy. The default (about minus 2.1 billion) means no lower limit.

maxPointsNeededForBuy.label: Maximum reputation to buy
maxPointsNeededForBuy.help: Highest reputation a player may have and still buy. The default (about 2.1 billion) means no upper limit.

minPointsNeededForSell.label: Minimum reputation to sell
minPointsNeededForSell.help: Lowest reputation a player may have and still sell. The default means no lower limit.

maxPointsNeededForSell.label: Maximum reputation to sell
maxPointsNeededForSell.help: Highest reputation a player may have and still sell. The default means no upper limit.

givePlayerPointsForBuy.label: Points for buying
givePlayerPointsForBuy.help: Reputation points gained per purchase. Only used when reputation is enabled.

givePlayerPointsForSell.label: Points for selling
givePlayerPointsForSell.help: Reputation points gained per sale. Only used when reputation is enabled.

version.label: Format version
version.help: Version number of this file format. The mod uses it to upgrade old files. Never change it.

files.title: Dealer list
files.summary: Dealers that exist and where the first showroom is built.

version.label: Format version
version.help: Version number of this file format. The mod uses it to upgrade old files. Never change it.

isInitialized.label: Initialised marker
isInitialized.help: Set by the mod after it has written the default file. Never change it; resetting it can make the mod regenerate defaults.

firstPositionOfShowroom.label: First showroom position
firstPositionOfShowroom.help: Where the first indoor showroom is built, normally a spot outside the playable map. Each further showroom is placed 50 metres higher.

firstPositionOfShowroom[].label: Coordinate value
firstPositionOfShowroom[].help: One number of an [X, Y, Z] triple: X is east-west, Y is height, Z is north-south on the map.

dealerPointsNames.label: Dealer names
dealerPointsNames.help: Dealers that exist. Each name must match a file in the DealerPoints folder.

dealerPointsNames[].label: Dealer name
dealerPointsNames[].help: Name of one dealer; must match a file in DealerPoints.

files.title: Dealer (one file per dealer)
files.summary: Location, permissions, spawn spots and cars of one dealer.

uniqueName.label: Dealer id
uniqueName.help: Name of this dealer; must match the file name and the entry in DealerPoints.json.

version.label: Format version
version.help: Version number of this file format. The mod uses it to upgrade old files. Never change it.

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.help: Name players see for this dealer.

playerCanSellCars.label: Players can sell cars
playerCanSellCars.help: Lets players sell their own vehicles here.

playerCanEnterShowRoom.label: Players can enter showroom
playerCanEnterShowRoom.help: Lets players walk into the showroom to look at cars.

playerCanBuyCars.label: Players can buy cars
playerCanBuyCars.help: Lets players buy vehicles here. Turn off for a look-only dealer.

acceptOnlyCash.label: Cash only
acceptOnlyCash.help: 1 means only cash carried by the player counts; money in a bank or ATM is ignored.

position.label: Dealer position
position.help: World position [X, Y, Z] of the dealer machine.

position[].label: Coordinate value
position[].help: One number of an [X, Y, Z] triple: X is east-west, Y is height, Z is north-south on the map.

orientation.label: Dealer orientation
orientation.help: Facing of the dealer in degrees (three angles).

orientation[].label: Angle value
orientation[].help: One angle of a three-value orientation, in degrees.

useExactPosition.label: Use exact position
useExactPosition.help: 0 places the dealer on the ground, 1 uses the coordinates as given.

spawnPosition.label: Vehicle spawn position
spawnPosition.help: Where a bought car appears [X, Y, Z]. Keep the spot free of buildings.

spawnPosition[].label: Coordinate value
spawnPosition[].help: One number of an [X, Y, Z] triple: X is east-west, Y is height, Z is north-south on the map.

spawnOrientation.label: Vehicle spawn orientation
spawnOrientation.help: Direction a bought car faces when it appears.

spawnOrientation[].label: Angle value
spawnOrientation[].help: One angle of a three-value orientation, in degrees.

useExactSpawnPosition.label: Use exact spawn position
useExactSpawnPosition.help: 1 spawns the car exactly at the spawn position; 0 searches for a nearby free space.

sellPosition.label: Inspection position
sellPosition.help: Where the dealer inspects a car a player wants to sell.

sellPosition[].label: Coordinate value
sellPosition[].help: One number of an [X, Y, Z] triple: X is east-west, Y is height, Z is north-south on the map.

sellOrientation[].label: Angle value
sellOrientation[].help: One angle of a three-value orientation, in degrees.

scanBoxToFindCarsForSell.label: Sell scan box size
scanBoxToFindCarsForSell.help: Size [X, Y, Z] of the box searched for the player car when selling.

scanBoxToFindCarsForSell[].label: Coordinate value
scanBoxToFindCarsForSell[].help: One number of an [X, Y, Z] triple: X is east-west, Y is height, Z is north-south on the map.

testDriveReturnHeightOffset.label: Test drive return height offset
testDriveReturnHeightOffset.help: Height adjustment added to the spot where the player returns after a test drive.

parkingSignType.label: Parking sign class
parkingSignType.help: Class name of the sign object placed at the sell spot.

spawnParkingSign.label: Spawn parking sign
spawnParkingSign.help: Places a parking sign at the sell inspection spot.

parkingSignHeightOffset.label: Parking sign height offset
parkingSignHeightOffset.help: Height adjustment for the sign. Normally 1.

type.label: Dealer object
type.help: Class name of the dealer machine object.
type.risk: An unknown class means no dealer appears.

testDriveStartPosition.label: Test drive start spots
testDriveStartPosition.help: Spots where a test drive car appears; each has a position and an orientation.

testDriveStartPosition[].position.label: Test drive position
testDriveStartPosition[].position.help: World position [X, Y, Z] of a test drive start spot.

testDriveStartPosition[].position[].label: Coordinate value
testDriveStartPosition[].position[].help: One number of an [X, Y, Z] triple: X is east-west, Y is height, Z is north-south on the map.

testDriveStartPosition[].orientation.label: Test drive orientation
testDriveStartPosition[].orientation.help: Facing of the test drive car at this spot.

testDriveStartPosition[].orientation[].label: Angle value
testDriveStartPosition[].orientation[].help: One angle of a three-value orientation, in degrees.

uniqueFileNames.label: Cars for sale
uniqueFileNames.help: Names of car config files (CarConfigs folder) offered at this dealer.

uniqueFileNames[].label: Car file name
uniqueFileNames[].help: Name of one car config file.

enableNpcTrader.label: Show NPC dealer
enableNpcTrader.help: Places a character next to the machine.

npcType.label: NPC class
npcType.help: Class name of the character model for the NPC dealer.

npcGearSetName.label: NPC gear set
npcGearSetName.help: Name of the outfit for the NPC. Created if it does not exist. Empty uses default clothes.

files.title: Transaction logging
files.summary: Where car purchases and sales are logged.

version.label: Format version
version.help: Version number of this file format. The mod uses it to upgrade old files. Never change it.

logBuyCSV.label: Log buys to CSV
logBuyCSV.help: Writes every car purchase to a CSV file on the server.

logBuyDiscord.label: Log buys to Discord
logBuyDiscord.help: Posts every car purchase to the buy webhook address.

discordBuyWebhookURL.label: Discord webhook address
discordBuyWebhookURL.help: Web address that car purchases are posted to when the matching Discord switch is on. Treat it like a password: anyone holding it can post to that channel. Leave empty if you do not use it.
discordBuyWebhookURL.risk: A wrong or revoked address silently loses the messages.

logSellCSV.label: Log sells to CSV
logSellCSV.help: Writes every car sale to a CSV file.

logSellDiscord.label: Log sells to Discord
logSellDiscord.help: Posts every car sale to the sell webhook address.

discordSellWebhookURL.label: Discord webhook address
discordSellWebhookURL.help: Web address that car sales are posted to when the matching Discord switch is on. Treat it like a password: anyone holding it can post to that channel. Leave empty if you do not use it.
discordSellWebhookURL.risk: A wrong or revoked address silently loses the messages.

files.title: Price item (one file per item)
files.summary: Price and attachments of one car or part.

uniqueName.label: Item id
uniqueName.help: Name of this price entry; must match the file name. Car configs refer to it.

type.label: Item class
type.help: Class name of the vehicle or part, as in types.xml.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.help: Amount of the item in percent (fill level). 100 is full.

sellPrice.label: Sell price
sellPrice.help: What a player would get for selling it. The documentation says this is not implemented yet.

currencyType.label: Currency
currencyType.help: Currency used. "default" uses the main currency from the shared currency config.

buyPrice.label: Buy price
buyPrice.help: Price a player pays for this item.

isPremium.label: Premium only
isPremium.help: Only premium players can buy this item.

amountItem.label: Amount per purchase
amountItem.help: How many of this item are given per purchase; used mainly for optional attachments.

attachmentUniqueNames.label: Included attachments
attachmentUniqueNames.help: Price item names that come with the item at no extra cost.

attachmentUniqueNames[].label: Attachment name
attachmentUniqueNames[].help: Name of one included price item.

optionalAttachmentUniqueNames.label: Optional attachments
optionalAttachmentUniqueNames.help: Price item names offered for extra money and not shown in the showroom.

version.label: Format version
version.help: Version number of this file format. The mod uses it to upgrade old files. Never change it.
